title: About Typle
intro: A typing app for practicing with word lists you create yourself. Add any words you like, practice them, and track your progress with your best records.

create.title: Create a list
create.description: Add the words you want to learn. The word to display and the characters to type can be set separately, and you can also add words from CSV or TSV files.

play.title: Practice
play.description: Speed, accuracy, and mistakes are shown as you type, along with where you typed a wrong character.

rankings.title: Best records
rankings.description: See your progress through your personal best, the average of your last 5 runs, and how your time has changed.

storage.title: Where your data is saved
storage.text: Word lists, practice history, and devices are saved only in this browser. To use a word list in another browser or on another device, export it as CSV and import it there.
storage.more: See <link>“Storage and data” in How to use</link> for details.

browser.title: This browser
browser.p2: Not synced with other devices or browsers
browser.p3: Lost when you clear the browser’s data

reports.title: Error reports
reports.text: To investigate problems, we may send details of errors and the environment where they occurred (browser, OS, and so on). Before sending, request contents such as word lists, cookies, user information, and the history of your actions are removed.

version.title: Version and development
version.private: This is a private repository. It can only be opened with GitHub accounts that have been granted access.
